units.en: Xuanzhen submitted a petition stating, "In the twelfth month of the third year of Kaicheng, with funds provided by Military Governor Lu Jun of Lingnan from his salary, grieving that my family's coffins from three generations lie exposed in different places, I have arranged for them to be brought home for burial in the ancestral tomb.
units.literal: Xuanzhen submitted a petition stating, "Within the twelfth month of the third year of Kaicheng, receiving support from Military Governor Lu Jun of Lingnan from his salary funds, grieving that my family's three generations of traveling coffins lie exposed, each in a different place, I specially arranged their dispatch to return to the great tomb for joint burial.

units.zh: 今護四喪，已到長樂旅店權下，未委故越王墳所在，伏乞天恩，允妾所奏，許歸大塋。
units.en: I am now escorting four coffins and have temporarily lodged at an inn at Changle; I do not know where the tomb of the former Prince of Yue lies; I humbly beg Your Majesty to grant my petition and permit burial in the ancestral tomb.
units.literal: Now escorting four coffins, I have reached a Changle inn and lodged there temporarily; I do not know the location of the former Prince of Yue's tomb; I humbly beg Heaven's grace to grant my petition and permit return to the great tomb.

units.zh: 妾年已六十三，孤露家貧，更無依倚。」
units.en: I am sixty-three years old, orphaned and destitute, with no one left to rely upon."
units.literal: I am already sixty-three, orphaned and exposed, my household poor, with no further support."

units.zh: 詔曰：「越王事跡，國史著明，枉陷非辜，尋已洗雪。
units.en: An edict stated, "The deeds of the Prince of Yue are clearly recorded in the dynastic histories; wrongly implicated without guilt, his name was long since cleared.
units.literal: An edict stated, "The deeds of the Prince of Yue are clearly recorded in the dynastic history; wrongly implicated without guilt, his name was soon cleared.

units.zh: 其珍子他事配流，數代漂零，不還京國。
units.en: Zhenzi was banished for another offense; for generations the family drifted in exile, never returning to the capital.
units.literal: Zhenzi was banished for another affair; for generations they drifted in exile, not returning to the capital.

units.zh: 玄真弱女，孝節卓然，啟護四喪，綿歷萬里；
units.en: Xuanzhen, a frail woman, displays outstanding filial devotion, escorting four coffins across ten thousand li;
units.literal: Xuanzhen, a frail woman, displays outstanding filial constancy, undertaking to escort four coffins across ten thousand li;

units.zh: 況是近族，必可加恩。
units.en: moreover, as near kin, she surely deserves special favor.
units.literal: moreover as near kin, favor must surely be extended.

units.zh: 行路猶或嗟稱，朝廷固須恤助。
units.en: Travelers on the road still sigh in admiration; the court must show compassion and aid.
units.literal: Travelers on the road still sigh in praise; the court must certainly show compassion and aid.

units.zh: 委宗正寺、京兆府與訪越王墳墓報知。
units.en: Commission the Court of the Imperial Clan and the Metropolitan Prefecture to locate the Prince of Yue's tomb and report back.
units.literal: Commission the Court of the Imperial Clan and the Metropolitan Prefecture to seek out the Prince of Yue's tomb and report.

units.zh: 如不是陪陵，任祔塋次卜葬。
units.en: If it is not an attendant tomb, permit burial in the secondary plot as divination directs.
units.literal: If it is not an attendant tomb, permit burial in the secondary plot according to divination.

units.zh: 其葬事仍令京兆府接措，必使備禮。
units.en: The Metropolitan Prefecture shall handle the burial and ensure full ceremony.
units.literal: The burial affairs shall still be handled by the Metropolitan Prefecture, ensuring full ritual.

units.zh: 葬畢，玄真如願住京城，便配咸宜觀安置。」
units.en: When the burial is complete, if Xuanzhen wishes to remain in the capital, assign her residence at Xianyi Abbey."
units.literal: When the burial is complete, if Xuanzhen wishes to dwell in the capital, assign her residence at Xianyi Abbey."

units.zh: 孝女王和子者，徐州人。
units.en: The filial daughter Wang Hezi was a native of Xu Prefecture.
units.literal: The filial daughter Wang Hezi was a native of Xuzhou.

units.zh: 其父及兄為防秋卒，戍涇州。
units.en: Her father and elder brother were frontier-defense soldiers garrisoned at Jing Prefecture.
units.literal: Her father and elder brother were autumn-defense soldiers garrisoned at Jingzhou.

units.zh: 元和中，吐蕃寇邊，父兄戰死，無子，母先亡。
units.en: During the Yuanhe reign the Tibetans raided the frontier; her father and brother died in battle; there were no sons; her mother had died earlier.
units.literal: During the Yuanhe era the Tibetans raided the border; her father and brother died in battle; there were no sons; her mother had died earlier.

units.zh: 和子時年十七，聞父兄歿於邊上，被髮徒跣缞裳，獨往涇州。
units.en: Hezi was seventeen; hearing that her father and brother had died on the frontier, she went alone to Jing Prefecture with hair unbound, barefoot, in mourning garments.
units.literal: Hezi was then seventeen; hearing her father and brother had died on the frontier, with hair unbound and barefoot in mourning garments she went alone to Jingzhou.

units.zh: 行丐取父兄之喪，歸徐營葬。
units.en: Begging along the way, she retrieved her father and brother's remains, returned to Xu Prefecture, and gave them proper burial.
units.literal: Traveling as a beggar she retrieved her father and brother's remains, returned to Xu, and arranged burial.

units.zh: 手植松柏，剪發壞形，廬於墓所。
units.en: She planted pine and cypress with her own hands, cut her hair and disfigured her appearance, and lived in a mourning hut beside the tomb.
units.literal: She planted pine and cypress with her own hands, cut her hair and disfigured her form, and dwelt in a hut at the tomb.

units.zh: 節度使王智興以狀聞，詔旌表之。
units.en: Military Governor Wang Zhixing reported her deeds, and an edict honored her household.
units.literal: Military Governor Wang Zhixing reported the circumstances and an edict honored her household.

units.zh: 又大中五年，兗州瑕丘縣人鄭神佐女，年二十四，先許適馳雄牙官李玄慶。
units.en: Also in the fifth year of Dazhong, the daughter of Zheng Shenzuo of Xiqiu County in Yan Prefecture, aged twenty-four, had been betrothed to Li Xuanqing, an officer of the Chixiong garrison.
units.literal: Also in the fifth year of Dazhong, the daughter of Zheng Shenzuo of Xiqiu County in Yanzhou, aged twenty-four, had been betrothed to Li Xuanqing, an officer of the Chixiong garrison.

units.zh: 神佐亦為官健，戍慶州。
units.en: Shenzuo also served as a government soldier garrisoned at Qing Prefecture.
units.literal: Shenzuo also served as a government soldier garrisoned at Qingzhou.

units.zh: 時党項叛，神佐戰死，其母先亡，無子。
units.en: When the Tangut rebelled, Shenzuo died in battle; his mother had died earlier, and there were no sons.
units.literal: At the time the Tangut rebelled; Shenzuo died in battle; his mother had died earlier; there were no sons.

units.zh: 女以父戰歿邊城，無由得還，乃剪發壞形，自往慶州護父喪還，至瑕丘縣進賢鄉馬青村，與母合葬。
units.en: Because her father had died in battle at a distant fortress with no means of bringing his body home, the daughter cut her hair and disfigured her appearance, traveled alone to Qing Prefecture to escort her father's remains home, and buried him beside her mother in Maqing Village, Jinxian Township, Xiqiu County.
units.literal: The daughter, because her father had died in battle at the border fortress with no means of return, cut her hair and disfigured her form, went herself to Qingzhou to escort her father's remains home, reaching Maqing Village in Jinxian Township of Xiqiu County, and buried him together with her mother.

units.zh: 便廬於墳所，手植松檜，誓不適人。
units.en: She then lived in a mourning hut beside the grave, planted pine and cypress with her own hands, and vowed never to marry.
units.literal: She then dwelt in a hut at the grave, planted pine and cypress with her own hands, and vowed never to marry.

units.zh: 節度使蕭椒以狀奏之曰：「伏以閭裏之中，罕知禮教，女子之性，尤昧義方。
units.en: Military Governor Xiao Jiao memorialized, "I humbly observe that in village neighborhoods, ritual instruction is rarely known, and women especially lack understanding of righteousness.
units.literal: Military Governor Xiao Jiao memorialized in a report, "I humbly observe that among village neighborhoods, ritual instruction is rarely known; the nature of women especially lacks understanding of righteousness.

units.zh: 鄭氏女痛結窮泉，哀深《陟岵》，投身沙磧，歸父遺骸，遠自邊陲，得還閭裏。
units.en: The daughter of the Zheng clan, her grief reaching to the underworld, her sorrow as deep as the 'Ascending the Mound,' braved the desert wastes to bring her father's remains home from the distant frontier to her native village.
units.literal: The daughter of the Zheng clan, grief bound to the deep springs, sorrow deep as the 'Ascending the Mound,' cast herself into sandy wastes to return her father's remains, coming from far borderlands back to her native village.

units.zh: 感《蓼莪》以積恨，守丘墓以誓心。
units.en: Moved by the 'Polygala,' she nursed bitter grief; guarding the tomb mound, she pledged her heart.
units.literal: Moved by the 'Polygala' she accumulated bitter grief; guarding the mound and tomb she pledged her heart.

units.zh: 克彰孝理之仁，足厲貞方之節。」
units.en: She fully displayed the benevolence of filial devotion and amply exemplified the constancy of chaste conduct."
units.literal: She fully displayed the benevolence of filial principle and sufficiently inspired the constancy of chaste conduct."

units.zh: 詔旌表門閭。
units.en: An edict honored her household.
units.literal: An edict honored her household gate.

units.zh: 贊曰：政教隆平，男忠女貞。
units.en: The encomium states: When government and instruction flourish in peace, men are loyal and women constant.
units.literal: The encomium states: When government and instruction flourish in peace, men are loyal and women chaste.

units.zh: 禮以自防，義不茍生。
units.en: Through ritual they guard themselves; through righteousness they refuse to live in shame.
units.literal: Through ritual they guard themselves; through righteousness they do not cling to life in degradation.

units.zh: 彤管有煒，蘭閨振聲。
units.en: The historian's red brush shines bright; women's chambers resound with fame.
units.literal: The red brush shines bright; orchid chambers resound with fame.

units.zh: 《關雎》合《雅》，始號文明。
units.en: When 'Guan Ju' harmonizes with the 'Ya' hymns, civilization is first proclaimed.
units.literal: When 'Guan Ju' harmonizes with the 'Ya' hymns, civilization is first proclaimed.

units.zh: 時有柳直求婚，許之。
units.en: At that time a man named Liu Zhi sought her hand in marriage, and Ju consented.
units.literal: At the time Liu Zhi sought her hand in marriage, and he agreed.

units.zh: 後十餘年間，與德武音信斷絕。
units.en: For more than ten years afterward, all communication with Li Dewu ceased.
units.literal: For more than ten years thereafter, correspondence with Dewu was cut off.

units.zh: 王智興，字匡諫，懷州溫縣人也。
units.en: Wang Zhixing, styled Kuangjian, was a native of Wen County in Huai Prefecture.
units.literal: Wang Zhixing, style name Kuangjian, was a native of Wen County in Huai Prefecture.

units.zh: 自是，智興常以徐軍抗納，累歷滕、豐、沛、狄四鎮將。
units.en: Thereafter Zhixing led Xu troops against Na and in turn commanded the garrisons at Teng, Feng, Pei, and Di.
units.literal: From this, Zhixing constantly used the Xu army to resist Na, and successively served as garrison commander of the four posts Teng, Feng, Pei, and Di.

units.zh: 穆宗素知智興善將，遷檢校左散騎常侍、兼御史大夫，充武寧軍節度副使、河北行營都知兵馬使。
units.en: Muzong, knowing Zhixing's skill as a commander, promoted him to acting left regular attendant and censor grandee, made him vice military governor of the Wuning Army, and named him chief controller of the Hebei field headquarters.
units.literal: Muzong had long known Zhixing was skilled as a general; he was transferred to Acting Left Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, concurrently Censor Grandee, serving as Vice Military Governor of the Wuning Army and Chief Controller of Military Affairs for the Hebei Field Headquarters.

units.zh: 智興少驍銳，為徐州衙卒，事刺史李洧。
units.en: In youth Zhixing was bold and keen; he served as a Xu Prefecture yamen soldier under Prefect Li Wei.
units.literal: Zhixing in youth was fierce and sharp; he was a Xu Prefecture yamen soldier and served Prefect Li Wei.

units.zh: 累官至侍御史、本軍都押衙。
units.en: He rose to palace censor and chief superintendent of the circuit army.
units.literal: He cumulatively reached the office of Palace Censor and Chief Superintendent of the Circuit Army.

units.zh: 德宗發朔方軍五千人隨智興赴之，淄青圍解。
units.en: Dezong sent five thousand Shuo-fang troops with Zhixing to the rescue, and the Ziqing siege was broken.
units.literal: Dezong dispatched five thousand Shuo-fang troops to follow Zhixing and go to their aid; the Zi-qing siege was lifted.

units.zh: 元和中，王師誅吳元濟，李師道與蔡賊謀撓沮王師，頻出軍侵徐，徐帥李願以所部步騎悉委智興以抗之。
units.en: During the Yuanhe reign, while imperial forces campaigned to destroy Wu Yuanji, Li Shidao joined the Cai rebels in harassing the court's armies and repeatedly raided Xu; Military Governor Li Yuan put all his infantry and cavalry under Zhixing to repel them.
units.literal: In the Yuanhe reign, the imperial army executed Wu Yuanji; Li Shidao with the Cai rebels plotted to thwart and discourage the imperial army, frequently sending out troops to invade Xu; the Xu commander Li Yuan entrusted all the infantry and cavalry under his command to Zhixing to resist them.

units.zh: 十三年，王師誅李師道，智興率徐軍八千會諸道之師進擊。
units.en: In the thirteenth year (818), as the imperial army moved to destroy Li Shidao, Zhixing led eight thousand Xu troops to join the allied armies in the advance.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year, the imperial army executed Li Shidao; Zhixing led eight thousand Xu troops to join the armies of the various circuits in advancing to attack.

units.zh: 長慶初，河朔復亂，征兵進討。
units.en: Early in the Changqing reign, Hebei erupted in rebellion again, and the court mobilized troops for a punitive campaign.
units.literal: At the beginning of Changqing, Hebei again fell into disorder; troops were levied to advance and punish.

units.zh: 父縉，太子詹事。
units.en: His father Jin served as Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: His father Jin was Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 祖瑰，右金吾衛將軍。
units.en: His grandfather Gui was general of the Right Gold Crow Guard.
units.literal: His grandfather Gui was General of the Right Gold Crow Guard.

units.zh: 曾祖靖，左武衛將軍。
units.en: His great-grandfather Jing served as general of the Left Martial Guard.
units.literal: His great-grandfather Jing was General of the Left Martial Guard.

units.zh: 智興健行，不四五日賫表京師求援。
units.en: Zhixing was a strong runner; within four or five days he carried memorials swiftly to the capital seeking relief.
units.literal: Zhixing was a strong traveler; in no more than four or five days he carried memorials swiftly to the capital to seek relief.

units.zh: 自是二十余年為徐將。
units.en: For more than twenty years thereafter he served as a Xu commander.
units.literal: From this for more than twenty years he was a Xu commander.

units.zh: 鄆將王朝晏以兵攻沛，智興擊敗之。
units.en: Yan commander Wang Chaoyan attacked Pei; Zhixing routed him.
units.literal: The Yan commander Wang Chaoyan attacked Pei with troops; Zhixing struck and defeated him.

units.zh: 賊又令姚海率勁兵二萬圍豐，攻城甚急。
units.en: The rebels next sent Yao Hai with twenty thousand elite troops to besiege Feng in a fierce assault.
units.literal: The rebels again ordered Yao Hai to lead twenty thousand crack troops to besiege Feng; the assault on the city was very urgent.

units.zh: 智興復擊敗之。
units.en: Zhixing defeated them again.
units.literal: Zhixing again struck and defeated them.

units.zh: 於賊壁獲美妾，智興懼軍士爭之，乃曰：「軍中有女子，安得不敗？
units.en: After capturing a beautiful woman in the enemy camp, Zhixing feared the troops would fight over her and said, "An army that keeps women cannot help but be defeated.
units.literal: At the rebel ramparts he captured a beautiful concubine; Zhixing feared the soldiers would quarrel over her, and therefore said: "When there are women in the army, how can one not be defeated?

units.zh: 此雖無罪，違軍法也。」
units.en: Though she is innocent, this violates military law."
units.literal: Although this person is without guilt, it violates military law."

units.zh: 即斬之以徇。
units.en: He beheaded her on the spot as an example.
units.literal: He immediately beheaded her to display.

units.zh: 與陳許之軍大破賊於金鄉，拔魚臺，俘斬萬計，以功遷御史中丞。
units.en: With the Chenxu army he routed the rebels at Jinxiang, took Yutai, and killed or captured tens of thousands; for this he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: With the Chen and Xu armies he greatly defeated the rebels at Jinxiang, captured Yutai, and captives and slain numbered in the tens of thousands; for merit he was transferred to Vice Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 賊平，授沂州刺史。
units.en: After the rebellion was suppressed, he was appointed prefect of Yi Prefecture.
units.literal: When the rebels were pacified, he was appointed Prefect of Yi Prefecture.

units.zh: 洧遂以徐州歸國。
units.en: Wei thereupon submitted Xu Prefecture to the Tang court.
units.literal: Wei then submitted Xu Prefecture to the state.

units.zh: 時曹升任徐州刺史，知賊降，領兵掩襲。
units.en: At the time Cao Sheng was Prefect of Xuzhou; learning the bandits had surrendered, he led troops in a surprise attack.
units.literal: At the time Cao Sheng served as Prefect of Xuzhou; learning the bandits had surrendered, he led troops in a surprise attack.

units.zh: 又至德初，為國用不足，令第五琦於諸道榷鹽以助軍用，及晏代其任，法益精密，官無遺利。
units.en: Early in the Zhide era, with state funds short, Di Wuqi was ordered to monopolize salt in the circuits for military expenses; when Yan took over, the system grew more precise and the treasury left no revenue uncollected.
units.literal: Moreover, at the beginning of Zhide, because state revenue was insufficient, Di Wuqi was ordered to monopolize salt in the various circuits to aid military expenses; when Yan succeeded to his post, the law grew more precise and the government left no profit uncollected.

units.zh: 初平希烈，吳少誠殺陳仙奇，上以襄、鄧要厄，三年，除襄州刺史、山南東道節度等使，割汝、隨隸焉。
units.en: After Li Xilie was subdued, Wu Shaocheng murdered Chen Xianqi. Considering Xiang and Deng strategic passes, in 787 the court appointed Li Gao prefect of Xiang Prefecture and military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit, attaching Ru and Suizhou to his jurisdiction.
units.literal: When Xilie was first pacified, Wu Shaocheng killed Chen Xianqi; the emperor considered Xiang and Deng strategic choke points; in the third year, he was appointed prefect of Xiang Prefecture, military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit and related posts; Ru and Sui were severed and placed under his command.

units.zh: 練兵積糧，市回鶻馬益騎兵，堂大畋以教士，少誠憚之。
units.en: He trained troops, stockpiled grain, bought Uighur horses to expand his cavalry, and held great hunts to drill his men. Wu Shaocheng grew wary of him.
units.literal: He drilled troops and stockpiled grain, purchased Uighur horses to increase cavalry, and held great hunts in the hall grounds to train soldiers; Shaocheng feared him.

units.zh: 乳母王氏，號蘭英，請髡鉗，求入保養，世充許之。
units.en: His wet nurse Wang Shi, known as Lanying, asked to be shorn and shackled so she could enter the prison to care for him; Wang Shichong consented.
units.literal: His wet-nurse Wang Shi, called Lanying, requested to be shaved and shackled in order to enter and nurture him; Shichong granted it.

units.zh: 高祖嘉其義，下詔曰：「師仁乳母王氏，慈惠有聞，撫鞠無倦，提攜遺幼，背逆歸朝。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu praised her conduct and issued an edict: "Shiren's wet nurse Wang Shi is renowned for kindness and grace; she reared him without rest, guided the orphaned child, and turned from rebellion to bring him back to the Tang court.
units.literal: Gaozu commended her righteousness and issued an edict: "Shiren's wet-nurse Wang Shi is known for kindness and grace, rearing without weariness, guiding the orphaned infant, turning from rebellion to return to the court.

units.zh: 蘭英撫育提攜，備盡筋力。
units.en: Lanying raised and guided him, exhausting every ounce of her strength.
units.literal: Lanying reared and guided him, exhausting all her strength.

units.zh: 時喪亂年饑，人多鋨死，蘭英扶路乞丐捃拾。
units.en: In those years of chaos and famine many starved to death; Lanying went begging along the roads to gather whatever she could find.
units.literal: At the time there was turmoil and famine year after year; many died of starvation; Lanying, supporting herself along the road, begged and gathered scraps.

units.zh: 蘭英唯啖土飲水而已。
units.en: Lanying herself ate only scraps of earth and drank only water.
units.literal: Lanying herself ate only earth and drank only water.

units.zh: 可封永壽郡君」。
units.en: Let her be enfeoffed as Lady of Yongshou Commandery."
units.literal: She may be enfeoffed as Lady of Yongshou Commandery."

units.zh: 後詐采拾，乃竊師仁歸於京師。
units.en: Later she pretended to go out gathering and secretly carried Shiren away to the capital.
units.literal: Later, pretending to go gathering, she stole Shiren away and returned to the capital.

units.zh: 遇有所得，便歸與師仁；
units.en: Whatever she obtained she brought back at once for Shiren;
units.literal: whenever she obtained anything, she at once returned and gave it to Shiren;

units.zh: 宜有褒隆，以錫其號。
units.en: She deserves honor and elevation, and should be granted a title.
units.literal: She should receive commendation and elevation, and be granted a title.

units.zh: 孝女王和子孝女王和子者，徐州人。
units.en: The Filial Daughter Wang Hezi was a native of Xuzhou.
units.literal: The Filial Daughter Wang Hezi—the Filial Daughter Wang Hezi was a native of Xuzhou.

units.zh: 和子時年十七，聞父兄歿於邊上，被髮徒跣缞裳，獨往涇州。
units.en: Hezi was then seventeen; hearing her father and brother had died on the frontier, with hair unbound, barefoot, and in hemp mourning garments, she went alone to Jing Prefecture.
units.literal: Hezi was then seventeen; hearing her father and brother had died on the frontier, with hair unbound, barefoot, and in hemp mourning garments, she went alone to Jingzhou.

units.zh: 其父及兄為防秋卒，戍涇州。
units.en: Her father and elder brother were frontier soldiers garrisoned at Jing Prefecture.
units.literal: Her father and elder brother were frontier-defense soldiers garrisoned at Jingzhou.

units.zh: 元和中，吐蕃寇邊，父兄戰死，無子，母先亡。
units.en: During the Yuanhe era Tibetans raided the border; her father and brother died in battle without sons; her mother had died earlier.
units.literal: During the Yuanhe era the Tibetans raided the border; her father and brother died in battle, leaving no sons; her mother had died earlier.

units.zh: 行丐取父兄之喪，歸徐營葬。
units.en: She went begging along the road to recover her father and brother's remains, returned to Xu, and arranged their burial.
units.literal: She went begging along the road to recover her father and brother's coffins, returned to Xu, and arranged their burial.

units.zh: 手植松柏，剪髮壞形，廬於墓所。
units.en: With her own hands she planted pine and cypress, cut her hair and marred her form, and lived in a hut at the grave.
units.literal: With her own hands she planted pine and cypress, cut her hair and marred her form, and lived in a hut at the grave.

units.zh: 節度使王智興以狀聞，詔旌表之。
units.en: Military Governor Wang Zhixing reported the facts; an edict honored her household.
units.literal: Military Governor Wang Zhixing reported the facts; an edict marked her gate and lane.

units.zh: 及密敗，為王世充所殺。
units.en: When Mi was defeated, Wang Shichong killed him.
units.literal: When Mi was defeated, he was killed by Wang Shichong.

units.zh: 武都子師仁，年始三歲，世充以其年幼不殺，使禁掌之。
units.en: Wudu's son Shiren was only three years old; Wang Shichong spared him because of his age and had him imprisoned under guard.
units.literal: Wudu's son Shiren was only three years old; Shichong, because he was young, did not kill him but had him confined and kept in custody.

units.zh: 時又有獨孤武都，謀叛王世充歸國，事覺誅死。
units.en: At that time Dugu Wudu also plotted to defect from Wang Shichong to the Tang; when the plot was discovered he was put to death.
units.literal: At the same time there was also Dugu Wudu, who plotted to rebel against Wang Shichong and return to the Tang; the affair was discovered and he was executed.

units.zh: 始自約敕之時，意乃慕宋伯姬及陳孝婦，不幸一為盜賊所污，遂行淫失，知其非禮，然不能自還。
units.en: At first she means to emulate Lady Bo Ji of Song and the filial wife of Chen; once defiled by bandits, she falls into debauchery, knows it is wrong, yet cannot turn back.
units.literal: At first, in the time of self-restraint, her intent then admired Lady Bo Ji of Song and the filial wife of Chen; unluckily once defiled by robbers, she then practiced debauchery and loss, knowing it was not ritual, yet could not return herself.

units.zh: 學士張說以為禮記不刊之書，去聖久遠，不可改易，而唐貞觀顯慶禮，儀注前後不同，宜加折衷，以為唐禮。
units.en: Academician Zhang Yue held that the Book of Rites was an unalterable book, far from the sages and not to be changed, while Tang's Zhenguan and Xianqing rituals had ritual directions that differed before and after and should be harmonized into Tang ritual.
units.literal: Academician Zhang Yue held that the Book of Rites was an unalterable book, far from the sages and not to be changed, while Tang's Zhenguan and Xianqing rituals had ritual directions that differed before and after and should be harmonized into Tang ritual.

units.zh: 崔繪妻盧氏，幽州范陽人也，為山東著姓。
units.en: Lu Shi, wife of Cui Hui, was a native of Fanyang in You Prefecture and belonged to a prominent Shandong clan.
units.literal: Lu Shi, wife of Cui Hui—Lu Shi was a native of Fanyang in Youzhou, a prominent surname of Shandong.

units.zh: 累事吳少誠、少陽，至元濟時，為吳房令。
units.en: He served Wu Shaocheng and Shaoyang in succession; by Wu Yuanji's time he was Magistrate of Wufang.
units.literal: He served Wu Shaocheng and Shaoyang in succession; by Yuanji's time he was Magistrate of Wufang.

units.zh: 元和十五年，陳許節度使李遜疏楊氏之強明節義以聞，乃封北平郡太君。
units.en: In the fifteenth year of Yuanhe, Military Governor Li Xun of Chenxu memorialized Lady Yang's wisdom and moral integrity; she was enfeoffed as Grand Mistress of Beiping Commandery.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year of Yuanhe, Military Governor Li Xun of Chenxu memorialized Yang's forceful clarity and chaste righteousness; she was then enfeoffed as Grand Mistress of Beiping Commandery.
